## Summary

Describe the smallest externally observable change and its motivation.

## Verification

- [ ] `cargo xtask check`
- [ ] Kernel build and inspection, when affected
- [ ] Supported QEMU scenarios, when affected
- [ ] New or changed unsafe invariants are documented
- [ ] Dependency and license impact is documented
- [ ] No secrets, firmware, images, logs, build outputs, or machine-specific paths are included
